Class CacheService

java.lang.Object
services.CacheService
public class CacheService extends Object
Handles reading and writing persistent data to disk. All app data is stored as JSON under ~/.easypos/ This is the only class that should directly access those files. It provides helpers for other classes to use to load/save these files
